title: Delhi HC Grants TV Today an Anti-Suit Injunction Against a US Copyright Suit Over Weather Footage
case_name: T.V. Today Network Limited v. Global Weather Productions LLC & Ors.
card_summary: Global Weather Productions LLC and five individuals had sued TV Today Network in a US federal court over weather footage used in its Indian news broadcasts. On 5 November 2026, Justice Tejas Karia restrained them from pursuing that suit, calling it vexatious since the footage was made in India for an Indian audience. The order is a prima facie finding and does not rule on the copyright dispute itself.
card_tip: An Indian company sued abroad over content made and used only in India can approach the Delhi High Court for an anti-suit injunction instead of having to fight the foreign suit on its own terms.
verification_notes: The case number CS(COMM) 738/2026 (IA 18139/2026), the 5 November 2026 date, Justice Tejas Karia as the judge, and the identity of the defendants (Global Weather Productions LLC and five US individuals) are consistent across the LiveLaw, LawChakra and LiveLawBiz reports seen in this run. The characterisation of the order as a prima facie finding and the scope of the restraint (barring the US suit and any other proceeding abroad on the same subject matter) are corroborated by at least two of these sources. The order itself was not opened; only secondary reports were available on this run.
